External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

expected_source_revision.description: When supplied, a new intent requires this exact Meeting sealed revision; otherwise llm_source_changed. Accepted same-key same-body intents replay before current source/profile checks. Omission preserves legacy behavior.

artifact.description:
Present only when the export succeeds. The artifact must belong to
this export and pin exactly this job's manifest revision.

manifest_revision.description:
Immutable export manifest used to produce this artifact. It must
equal the owning ExportJob manifest_revision.

minutes_profile.description: Public approved Minutes profile. An absent or null profile disables new Minutes creation in consumers; never infer a template or model. Accepted intents remain replayable independently of the current profile.
